Equipment:Soot Blowers 
 for Long 
 Retractable,
 Multi-Nozzles Blower, Ljungstrom

This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must 
be performed every six months bases indicated by M6 in the above title block.

The
soot blowers used to clean 
Long Retractable, Multi-Nozzles 
Blower, Ljungstrom

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Abdel-Naeim 
Attallah Ahmed, reviewed 
& accepted by eng: Gomaa Lotfy: general director, revised by EDEPC quality control 
general director eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil, approved by eng: 
Mokhter Abd 
Elatif Mady: head sector of Ataka Power Station.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS Coordinator and certified 
 by accountant Mahmoud Soliman, EDEPC General director of admin, 
 financial inspection and supervisor of inspection and quality control head 
 sector.

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker for the motor of this soot blower.

Isolate the 
 electrical cable feeding of the motor of the 
 soot blower.

The soot blower 
 must be isolated mechanically by closing the main valve.
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller
Check the bearing of translating chain tensioner.
Check the chain of translation (state of links, tension).
Check the bearing and the condition of the gears of carriage.
Check the bearing of the bevel gear.
Check the shapes of the lance (wearing, trace straightness).
Check the bearings and the oil level of the speed reducer
Check the valve (trace, tightness).
Check the packing and solid gland and change them if needed.
Check the oil level at the gear box of the carriage.
Check the carriage rollers and check for wear and change them if needed.
Check the front rollers torn correctly.
Check the shape parking of the carriage (not leakage of steam).
Check the rollers of the carriage turn correctly.
Check the Bearings of chain tensioner.
Check the bearing of the bevel gear of the chain.
Check the shape of the packing of the valve (not leakage of steam).
Check the oil level at the gear box of the carriage.
